tools.name: kinsta_get_api_key_info
tools.description: Details of the Kinsta API key in use: its name, status, expiry and the company id it belongs to. The key itself is never shown. GET /validate.

tools.name: kinsta_list_available_regions
tools.description: The data center regions (name and region code) the company can host sites in. GET /company/{id}/available-regions.

tools.name: kinsta_list_activity_logs
tools.description: The company's activity log (who did what: site actions, DNS, migrations, billing, notifications, user management), newest first, with type, status, time, initiator and a description. Page with limit and offset (the reply's total tells how many exist). GET /company/{id}/activity-logs.

tools.name: kinsta_list_sites
tools.description: List the company's WordPress sites (id, name, display name, status, labels). With include_environments the live/staging environment ids, primary domain, PHP version, WordPress version and SSH host/port come too: use those environment ids for the other tools. GET /sites.

tools.name: kinsta_get_site
tools.description: One site by id, with its status and environments. GET /sites/{site_id}.

tools.name: kinsta_list_site_environments
tools.description: The environments (live, staging, ...) of one site: id, name, PHP engine version, WordPress version, primary domain, edge cache and CDN ids. GET /sites/{site_id}/environments.

tools.name: kinsta_get_site_usage
tools.description: A site's usage for the current billing month: visits, bandwidth or CDN bandwidth. GET /sites/{site_id}/usage/{metric}/this-month.

tools.name: kinsta_list_environment_domains
tools.description: The domains attached to one environment (id, name, whether Kinsta DNS/Cloudflare is used). GET /sites/environments/{env_id}/domains.

tools.name: kinsta_list_company_domains
tools.description: All domains the company has in Kinsta DNS / hosting, across sites. GET /domains.

tools.name: kinsta_list_backups
tools.description: The backups of one environment (manual, scheduled and system): id, name, note, type and creation time (epoch ms). Backups cannot be restored or deleted from here. GET /sites/environments/{env_id}/backups.

tools.name: kinsta_list_plugins
tools.description: The plugins of one environment: name, title, status (active/inactive), version, available update version, vulnerability flags and the auto-update type. GET /sites/environments/{env_id}/wp-plugins.

tools.name: kinsta_list_themes
tools.description: The themes of one environment: name, title, status, version, available update version and vulnerability flags. GET /sites/environments/{env_id}/wp-themes.

tools.name: kinsta_get_logs
tools.description: Recent lines of an environment's error log, access log or Kinsta cache performance log, optionally within a time range and filtered by a search text. Returns the log as text (the newest lines the API gives). Access logs contain visitor IP addresses. GET /sites/environments/{env_id}/logs.

tools.name: kinsta_get_analytics
tools.description: Traffic and resource analytics for one environment: visits, bandwidth, CDN bandwidth, disk space, response codes, visit dispersion, or the top countries, cities, browsers, hosts, referrers, user agents or ASNs. Choose a time_span or a from/to date range (yyyy-mm-dd). The company id is filled in auto

tools.name: kinsta_get_force_https_status
tools.description: Whether the environment forces HTTPS (ENABLED_FOR_ALL, ENABLED_REDIRECT_TO_PRIMARY or DISABLED). GET /sites/environments/{env_id}/force-https-status.

tools.name: kinsta_list_redirect_rules
tools.description: The environment's redirect rules (from, to, type, domain, optional country/city targeting), paged. GET /sites/environments/{env_id}/redirect-rules.

tools.name: kinsta_list_denied_ips
tools.description: The IP addresses and ranges blocked from the environment. GET /sites/tools/denied-ips.

tools.name: kinsta_get_operation_status
tools.description: The status of an asynchronous operation (cache clear, PHP restart, manual backup, ...) by the operation_id the write tool returned. status 200 = finished, 202 = still running, other = failed. GET /operations/{operation_id}.

tools.name: kinsta_clear_site_cache
tools.description: WRITE: clear the page cache of one environment (the site is briefly slower while the cache warms up; nothing is lost). Returns an operation_id: check it with kinsta_get_operation_status. POST /sites/tools/clear-cache.

tools.name: kinsta_clear_edge_cache
tools.description: WRITE: clear Kinsta's edge cache for one environment, optionally only for one URL (and its subdirectories). Nothing is lost; pages are cached again on the next visits. Returns an operation_id. POST /sites/edge-caching/clear.

tools.name: kinsta_clear_cdn_cache
tools.description: WRITE: clear the CDN cache of one environment (nothing is lost; files are fetched from the origin again). Needs the environment's cdn_cache_id from kinsta_list_sites. Returns an operation_id. POST /sites/cdn/clear-cache.

tools.name: kinsta_restart_php
tools.description: WRITE: restart the PHP engine of one environment. Requests in flight fail and the site may be unavailable for a few seconds. Returns an operation_id. POST /sites/tools/restart-php.

tools.name: kinsta_create_manual_backup
tools.description: WRITE: start a manual backup of one environment, with an optional note. Kinsta limits the number of manual backups per environment; when the limit is reached the request fails and nothing is deleted. Returns an operation_id. POST /sites/environments/{env_id}/manual-backups.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: kinsta_list_activity_logs, kinsta_clear_site_cache · Private data: kinsta_get_api_key_info, kinsta_list_sites, kinsta_clear_cdn_cache · Public sink: kinsta_clear_site_cache, kinsta_clear_edge_cache, kinsta_clear_cdn_cache, kinsta_restart_php, kinsta_create_manual_backup.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: kinsta_list_activity_logs, kinsta_clear_site_cache · Private data: kinsta_get_api_key_info, kinsta_list_sites, kinsta_clear_cdn_cache · Public sink: kinsta_clear_site_cache, kinsta_clear_edge_cache, kinsta_clear_cdn_cache, kinsta_restart_php, kinsta_create_manual_backup

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
